Mechaman Smart Glove.name: Mechaman Smart Glove
Mechaman Smart Glove.description:
A biking glove that comes with a subdermal grip pre-installed and one additional slot reserved for a cyberarm upgrade.

Cyberware installed into your Cyberhand or meat hand are inaccessible while the Smart Glove is being worn.

Drink Master 3000 Refilll Chems.name: Drink Master 3000 Refilll Chems
Drink Master 3000 Refilll Chems.description:
Used to track the fill state of the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_gear.Item.DQ22OUTZiHGj8vWD]{Drink Master 3000}.

Consume this item before dispensing a drink.

ChipVault by SecSystems.name: ChipVault par SecSystems
ChipVault by SecSystems.description:
Can hold up to 8 pieces of Chipware. Chipware stored inside are immune to EMP effects.

System does not currently support chipware storage

Drink Master 3000.name: Cocktailotron 3000
Drink Master 3000.description:
Concoct delicious beverages from a library of 3000 recipes including @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_drugs.Item.PRLDaeBVeMuBBIeO]{Smash}. Can make 10 drinks before the internal reservoir needs to be refilled with chemicals worth 100eb.

Use @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_gear.Item.nswZViDvZUMIKyZe]{Drink Master 3000 Refilll Chems} to track fill state.

EL-F4-NT Linear Frame.name: Charpente linéaire EL-PH4-NT
EL-F4-NT Linear Frame.description:
Exoskeleton with a pair of Techtools pre-installed that does not require Interface Plugs to operate. Increases BODY to 12 while equipped.

Does not affect HP or Deathsave due to BODY increase — Not currently supported by system.

Everest VentureWare AirWell 50.name: Condensator 50 Everest VentureWare
Everest VentureWare AirWell 50.description: Produces enough water to sustain a person.

Everest VentureWare One Touch Habitat.name: Tente One Touch Everest VentureWare
Everest VentureWare One Touch Habitat.description: Provides protection from Exposure. Counts as Sleeping in the Wilderness or as Sleeping on the Streets.

Fūma Kotarō Linear Frame H.name: Fūma Kotarō Linear Frame H
Fūma Kotarō Linear Frame H.description:
An exoskeleton that is designed for cyber-ninjas.

  • Requires 2 @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.KofoAolDFb3rvpbL]{Interface Plugs}
  • Increases BODY to 12 while plugged in
  • Stealth +2
  • Contains a pair of pre-installed excellent quality heavy melee weapons
  • Drawing and sheathing the frame's weapons does not require an Action
  • A Conceal check is not required for the weapons concealed in the frame

Does not affect HP or Deathsave due to BODY increase — Not currently supported by system.

Fūma Kotarō Linear Frame VH.name: Fūma Kotarō Linear Frame VH
Fūma Kotarō Linear Frame VH.description:
An exoskeleton that is designed for cyber-ninjas.

  • Requires 2 @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.KofoAolDFb3rvpbL]{Interface Plugs}
  • Increases BODY to 12 while plugged in
  • Stealth +2
  • Contains a pair of pre-installed excellent quality very heavy & light melee weapons
  • Drawing and sheathing the frame's weapons does not require an Action
  • A Conceal check is not required for the weapons concealed in the frame

Does not affect HP or Deathsave due to BODY increase — Not currently supported by system.

Hydrosubsidium Universal Aqualung.name: Aquapoumon universel Hydrosubsidium
Hydrosubsidium Universal Aqualung.description: When worn, User can breathe underwater as long as within 10 m/yards of the surface.

Jeeves Executive Garment Bag.name: Housse à vêtements corporatistes Alfred P.
Jeeves Executive Garment Bag.description: Bag that can repair one piece of fashion or armor at a time. Cannot repair Luxury clothing

KillStrom Banshee Microphone.name: Micro Banshee KillStrom
KillStrom Banshee Microphone.description:
Wireless Microphone Headset that can link to your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}. Gives the User a +2 bonus to Play Instrument (Singing) while worn.

Doesn't stack with other bonuses to Play Instrument — Not enforced by system

KillStrom Sonic Boom Amp.name: Ampli Sonic Boom KillStrom
KillStrom Sonic Boom Amp.description:
While linked to an instrument, use an Action to make everyone within 10m/yds roll a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs} check. On a failure listeners suffer the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_critical-injuries-head.Item.qRkCxq0KTuBnw2wj]{Damaged Ear} critical injury for 1 minute.

Must be plugged into a wall socket.

KillStrom Typhoid Speaker.name: Haut-parleur Typhoid KillStrom
KillStrom Typhoid Speaker.description:
When linked to a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_gear.Item.NoN4GJNgu6tE6mqd]{KillStrom Sonic Boom Amp}, the DV is increased by 1 and the range is increased by 90m/yds.

Must be plugged into a wall socket.

KTech Doberman 500 Drone.name: KTech Doberman 500 Drone
KTech Doberman 500 Drone.description:
Canine Personal Drone that can be linked to an @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GqYz689ddSKQHMen]{Agent}. Can be neutralized in 5 min with a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.tech.skills.electronicOrSecurityTech #DV17 Electronic/Security Tech]]{DV17 Electronic/Security Tech} check. This drone is equipped with:

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.PxOjhUUs7cRULv75]{Exotic Very Heavy Melee}

  • Motion Detector

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.pJmvlPM82IPK9RCG]{Olfactory Boost} that can track @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_ammo.Item.2h87i3r9DkK7sabX]{Doberman 500 Marking Scent}

Laser Light Electric Guitar.name: Guitare électrique Laser Light
Laser Light Electric Guitar.description:
An @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.aiX4CSRjs0oKGIFK]{electric guitar} that provides a +1 to Play Instrument (Guitar) and counts as one installation of the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.VbMY2fs3im1sP2dJ]{Light Tattoo Fashionware} while equipped.

Doesn't stack with other bonuses to Play Instrument — Not enforced by system

LF-001 SWAT Linear Frame.name: Charpente linéaire CL-001 RAID
LF-001 SWAT Linear Frame.description:
Exoskeleton.

  • Requires 2 @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.KofoAolDFb3rvpbL]{Interface Plugs}
  • Increases BODY to 12 while plugged in
  • Ignores the normal movement penalty for climbing and swimming

Does not affect HP or Deathsave due to BODY increase — Not currently supported by system.

Modfire 10X Carrying Case.name: Modfire 10X Carrying Case
Modfire 10X Carrying Case.description: This foam lined carrying case can hold all of the components required to maintain and transform the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_weapons.Item.OqCYiOiTR4zpimAq]{ModFire 10X (Pistol)} into an @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.ncTaJeIRbjmLuAxM]{SMG }or @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.oXsfrhGrtFwR75rr]{Assault Rifle}.

Mr. Biscuit Multi-Food Processor.name: Robot de transformation alimentaire toutes denrées M. Biscuit
Mr. Biscuit Multi-Food Processor.description: Can sustain a group of up to 10 people when in the Outskirts.

Petrochem Nitro Ultra9.name: Nitro Ultra9 Petrochem
Petrochem Nitro Ultra9.description: Can be poured into a Vehicle's tank to refill it as an Action. Gives bonuses to movement at the expense of safety.

RapiDeploy Sheath.name: Étui Dégainexpress
RapiDeploy Sheath.description: Gives the User a +2 bonus to their Conceal/Reveal Object check if used to conceal a weapon that is already capable of concealment.

Shower•in•a•Can.name: Spray•Inodorant•en•Cannette
Shower•in•a•Can.description: Spray Deodorant. Desinfects and deodorize. One use per can.

SovOil Industrial Lubricant.name: Lubrifiant industriel SovOil
SovOil Industrial Lubricant.description: Industrial lubricant in a helpfully sized can.

SovOil Medical Lubricant.name: Lubrifiant médical SovOil
SovOil Medical Lubricant.description: Medical lubricant in a helpfully sized can.

SovOil Personal Lubricant.name: Lubrifiant personnel SovOil
SovOil Personal Lubricant.description: Personal lubricant in a helpfully sized can.

Streetcase by SecSystems.name: Streetcase par SecSystems
Streetcase by SecSystems.description: Can carry many easily accessible items that YOU need to stay safe.

Vermilion Linear Frame.name: Charpente linéaire Vermeille
Vermilion Linear Frame.description:
Linear Frame Exoskeleton

  • Requires 2 @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.KofoAolDFb3rvpbL]{Interface Plugs}
  • Increases BODY to 12 while plugged in
  • No movement penalty for jumping
  • Operates as if paired @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.QDM0kdE3MK9YzjY3]{Skate Feet} are installed

Does not affect HP or Deathsave due to BODY increase — Not currently supported by system.

WorldSat Aerial Sphere.name: Aérosphère WorldSat
WorldSat Aerial Sphere.description: When set up, provides access to a Citinet when within 50 miles of the city or of another set up WorldSat Aerial Sphere that is connected to the Citinet.

Zetatech Porta-Printer.name: Imprimante 3D portative Zetatech
Zetatech Porta-Printer.description: A portable workshop that allows a Tech to use Upgrade Expertise & Fabrication Expertise anywhere as long as they have access to @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.GPgc2QczR4H1rYPj]{Techtools}.
